# Preserve PR212's two missing point-foundation results

Fresh Sol/Ultra prover, one bounded mathematical implementation task. MAIN
authorizes this narrow preservation port after an independent source audit.
Work ONLY in fresh branch `issue-117-preserve-point-foundations-20260917` at
`/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-117-preserve-point-foundations-20260917`.
Initial/current-main source base `24906961bf355542ead568f991a5738cda96fe07`
is the daemon's verified PR460 merge. Primary workflow tools are under
`/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/local/bin/`. Trusted policies/personas come from
that base or published main; read the prover persona and relevant Lean,
paper-gap and blueprint conventions before editing.

Read `/tmp/pr212-preservation-20260917-report.md` completely (SHA256
`3acac8ed85a4e8719eeebba5e11b72f35c6d2ac351449fe187528fb4bd9a956e`).
It compares preserved PR212 `defb65fe22e425d4f268616791d3d800d25b266d`
against prior main5abb1eab. The subsequent460 merge changed subline names/
documentation, so recheck relevant interfaces on your actual base.
Preserved branch/worktree must remain untouched; extract only needed content
using git show. No wholesale stale merge, cherry-pick or old module overwrite.
Issue117 is already closed but PR212 is still open; neither is proof evidence.

Implement exactly the report's two required ports:
1. `exists_extendedQ` from old `Combining/Points.lean`: assemble the already
   proved `exists_combinedPointsWitness` and `extendedQ_spec` so the source
   `lem:qld-4-12` supplies the witness rather than assuming it. Preserve both
   ordered comparisons and self-consistency, projectivity, error quantifiers
   and paper domains. Use current Points APIs and imports.
2. `exists_exactly_linear_observables_commonAncilla` from old
   `Combining/Linearity.lean`: preserve the uniform optional ancilla choice
   before the finite-space/state/error/observable-family quantifiers and the
   corrected average squared distance2delta. Reuse current Naimark/BLR APIs.
   This is formalization support and DOES NOT prove the source's missing
   zero-state padding/absorption condition.

Read the primary paper passages and NV provider cited in the report BEFORE
editing. Update only matching current chapter15 entries and the existing
`qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex` discussion needed to express those
results truthfully. Keep source construction separate from conditional
consequences. Mark source qld-4-12 proof complete only after the assembled
theorem verifies; keep qld-4-13 and later open obligations visible. Do not
restore stale duplicate gap notes, old point proofs/imports, missing-file
blueprint claims, or the optional affine-collision API visibility change.

Scope: Points.lean, Linearity.lean, chapter15, the existing linearity gap note,
and generated blueprint/lean_decls only if synchronization requires it.
No new sorry/admit/axiom, bridge assumptions, changed paper theorem statements,
axiom bypass, workflow/telemetry source changes, speculative refactoring or
unrelated warnings cleanup. Preserve all current-main proof content.

MAIN bootstraps this worktree with stock worktree-setup before admission.
Recheck hooks and clean initial head. Use targeted Lean checks on each edited
file, proof-hole scan, and appropriate declaration/blueprint validation.
No full lake build/CI/rooted axiom audit: MAIN runs canonical gates after your
commit. Use existing private warm artifacts, never lake update/shared cache
writes/force-warm. If a focused module build is necessary for a changed import,
keep it narrow and report its exact command; never launch the umbrella build.

Commit the narrow verified change through ordinary hooks; do not push/open
PR/review/merge/close212 or117. Return checkpoint, changed paths, exact checks
and source/Lean assumptions/conclusions audits for both results. Include a
short PR-body draft following the project template, preserving provenance
from PR212 and explaining the still-open source padding/extended-lines limits.
Artifacts under `/tmp/pr212-preservation-port-20260917-*`.

Budget900s including final120 for validation/commit/report; absolute deadline
accompanies launch. No silent extension, no new proof attempt if the report's
small port proves materially wrong: preserve the useful patch and state the
specific obstruction. One task, one thread, then retire. You are an author,
so cannot independently review this work. No other worktree, descendants,
codex exec, dispatch.sh, review.sh, autofix, lane, alternative key, Opus runner,
daemon/key change or actual merge-gate call. Main plus one relay-1 delegate only.

Source paper/NV first; public constructed extendedQ and formalization-only uniform optional ancilla, truthful blueprint/gap updates, no padding discharge claim. Original212 branch untouched, no full stale merge/cherry-pick or optional unrelated API. Ordinary local commit allowed, no push/PR/review/CI/fullbuild/merge/closing issues, no source assumptions/sorry/axioms added. One delegate only, active helper claims untouched. MAIN canonical gates and genuinely independent fresh reviewer follow later. Absolute deadline overrides nominal900s.
